Help Scout — Mailbox API

helpscout/api · version 1

envs add helpscout/api

This declares the keys below in your catalog and sets none of them. A template is a schema for keys; it never carries a value.

Key Needed Kind Notes
HELPSCOUT_APP_ID required secret Help Scout has no plain API key: the Mailbox API is OAuth only, so this pair is what you hold and the access token is derived. Neither half is called confidential in the documentation.. where to get it
HELPSCOUT_APP_SECRET required secret The other half. The tokens it buys last two days and are replaced by expiry rather than rotation, which says nothing about rotating this.. where to get it
